A typical period on radio checks, minutes
Our newest handler welcomed everyone

Omar Kaur and Mei Suleiman joined the meeting, along with Benny.

The team reviewed routine desk work and shared a calm reminder that every animal case starts with clear notes, kind communication, and careful follow-up. The passenger coordinator explained the usual travel steps in plain language, covering document review, carrier checks, and the importance of confirming each detail before a trip. Care plans were discussed with attention to species, temperament, and comfort, so that each traveler can feel steady from the first contact to handover. The group also spoke about gentle handling, suitable rest arrangements, and keeping owners informed with a warm and steady tone.

Staff agreed to keep close watch on special requests and to raise concerns early, so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can support safe journeys and reduce stress for pets and families. A brief reminder was shared about staying attentive during busy periods and supporting one another across the desk. The meeting ended on a positive note with thanks for the team's care and focus.
